youtube_description:
Taylor Swift is facing backlash after a photo of her seemingly showing a white substance inside of her nostrils has gone viral.

In red carpet photos from the 2023 MTV VMAs, Taylor can be seen dressed in an all-black outfit, but in one of the photos, fans have alleged they can see a white substance on the inside of her nostrils, although some just think she needs a tissue.

Taylor’s behaviour has been questioned after one user tweeted the photo with a snowflake emoji, to which another user commented: “This is literally an edited picture.”
youtube_title: Fans spot 'white substance' in Taylor Swift's nostrils 👀
